title: The Verdict of Little Hawley
author: Astrid Ravensworth
blurb: Emrys Vane, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
